critical_code_review_comments: ai_actions.propose_action returns proposal_id + rows + supplier auto-picked from supplier_items via _first_supplier — correct behaviour.
ai_actions.confirm atomically claims pending→running via find_one_and_update, so double-confirm reliably returns 409 (verified).
ai_insights.scan uses upsert on key={entity_id}:{kind}:{subject}:{day} and only notifies on new insert — good dedupe (no duplicate bell spam if scanned repeatedly same day).
ai_chat_service._session_context appends KAMUS ISTILAH conditionally — depends on runtime value_of; note: since prompt prefix affects cache, changing glossary invalidates cache (acceptable).

Chat 'Batik Mega Mendung Premium' ambiguity: model correctly asks disambiguation (3 SKUs) rather than proposing wrong SKU — good safety default; the review request example wording may need to be more explicit (SKU) to force propose_action. Not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested testids verified: insights cards+scan+ask, action card+qty+confirm+dismiss+status, customer context navigation + thread-context)
